remarks: Classic Colonial set on a quiet cul-de-sac in sought after Riverside, offering space, ideal layout, and exceptional potential. This 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath home features a gracious floor plan with generously sized rooms, hardwood floors throughout, ideal for today's living. Highlights include a large primary suite with en-suite bath and walk-in closet, additional well-proportioned bedrooms, and a welcoming front porch perfect for relaxing with coffee overlooking the garden and its beautiful native blooms. The home is spacious throughout and provides an excellent opportunity to renovate and customize to your taste. Located in a prime Riverside neighborhood in the coveted North Mianus/Eastern school district. Sold as-is. Ideal for buyers looking to create their dream home in one of Greenwich's most desirable locations.
